t41_help_c3: Milder reactions count too, like getting confused or spaced out (dissociating) again and again. Get professional help right away if any of this is severe or risky, and especially if it keeps going or comes back while you're sober. If you can't tell whether you're safe, I'd treat that as risky. Don't suddenly quit a prescribed medicine, or anything your body is dependent on, just because it might be part of the problem; have a doctor help you stop safely.
